title: Noordveld Machinery: spare-parts ordering and warranty (synthetic reference)
description: Derived from the implemented Noordveld order flow (app/services/checkout.py, order_flow.py), roles (app/core/roles.py), warranty rules (app/lifecycle/rules.py) and tracking rules (app/logistics/rules.py). Confirmed rules cite that code. Anything not implemented is an assumption or an open business decision. Noordveld is a fictional demo company.

capability.name: Sell and support spare parts for installed machines

requirements.statement: A customer can find an orderable spare part by part number, name or alias.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Searching an exact part number returns that part.
A part that is not VERIFIED and orderable cannot be ordered, and the reason is shown.

requirements.statement: When a machine is selected, an order only accepts parts recorded as fitting that machine.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A part without a fitment record for the selected machine is refused with the reason that it is not recorded as fitting.

requirements.statement: The customer provides requester and receiver contact details and a recorded delivery destination.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A malformed email or phone number is refused and the field is named.
A destination that is not a recorded ship-to is refused.

requirements.statement: Availability is shown per depot, and unknown stock is never treated as zero.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A depot is selectable only if every line has known stock of at least the ordered quantity and a recorded route to the destination.
UNKNOWN stock is displayed as unknown and is never allocated.
Resubmitting with the same key returns the existing order and creates nothing new.

requirements.statement: Stock is reserved for every line of an order or for none.

acceptance_criteria.statement: If any line cannot be reserved, the order becomes ALLOCATION_FAILED and no stock changes.
Two orders cannot reserve the same units.

requirements.statement: Shipment progress and shipment exceptions are recorded and visible.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A shipment exception can be resumed, and a failed delivery can be cancelled.
Tracking events follow the allowed event sequence.

requirements.statement: Optional dealer installation is recorded until it completes.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An order without dealer service completes after delivery.
Completing the dealer service completes the order.

requirements.statement: A warranty claim receives a deterministic, explained outcome.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The outcome is ELIGIBLE, NOT_ELIGIBLE, REQUIRES_REVIEW or INSUFFICIENT_DATA, with the factors that decided it.

requirements.statement: Every order status change is recorded with its actor and time.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each order action writes a status event in the same transaction as the change.

requirements.statement: The backend enforces role permissions for every order action.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An End User attempting an Order Processor action is refused with 403.

responsibilities: Cancel own order while it is early

roles.name: Warranty reviewer (to be confirmed)

attributes.name: Catalogue status
attributes.description: Only VERIFIED parts can be ordered.

attributes.name: Orderable online
attributes.description: Missing means unknown, which is not orderable.

entities.name: Fitment
entities.description: A recorded part-to-machine fit. No record means not recorded, not proven incompatible.

entities.name: Depot stock
entities.description: Stock of one part at one depot.

attributes.name: Reserved quantity
attributes.description: Changed only by allocation, release and dispatch.

entities.name: Order
entities.source_system: Noordveld graph: Order (written by the order service)

attributes.name: Order number
attributes.description: Assigned by the order service from one counter (HCME-ORD-000001…).

attributes.name: Submission key
attributes.description: Generated per submission so a retry returns the same order.

attributes.name: Status
attributes.description: Changed only by order actions on the server.

attributes.name: Quantity
attributes.description: Merged per part and machine; at most 99.

attributes.name: Location
attributes.description: Only IN_TRANSIT may have no location.

attributes.name: Outcome
attributes.description: Set by the warranty evaluation, never typed in.

rules.description: A part must exist in the catalogue and be VERIFIED and orderable before it can be ordered.
rules.condition: part exists AND part_status = VERIFIED AND orderable = true

rules.description: Some parts need the machine variant identified before the right part is certain.

source.reference: IdentificationRequirement nodes are shown in part views but are not enforced at checkout

rules.description: When a machine is selected, a part that is not recorded as fitting that machine is refused.
rules.condition: no machine selected OR a fitment record exists for (part, machine)

rules.description: Requester and receiver need a name, a valid email and phone, and the destination must be a recorded ship-to.
If dealer installation is requested, the chosen dealer must be recorded as installing every ordered part.
A depot can supply the order only if every line has known stock of at least the quantity and a recorded route reaches the destination. Unknown stock is never treated as zero.
A repeated place-order with the same key returns the existing order; nothing new is created.
Order totals are not calculated; the freight figure is a synthetic estimate shown as context only.
Allocation reserves every line or none, in one transaction with row locks.
Two orders cannot reserve the same units.
From ALLOCATION_FAILED the processor can retry allocation, reject the order or cancel it.
Each order action is valid only from specific statuses and is checked on the server.
A dispatched shipment is delivered, reports an exception (which can be resumed), or fails delivery.

source.reference: app/services/order_flow.py ACTIONS deliver, shipment_exception, resume_shipment, delivery_failed

rules.description: Tracking events must start with ORDER_CONFIRMED or PICKED, follow the allowed transitions, and carry a location unless IN_TRANSIT.
An order with dealer service completes when the service completes; without service it completes after delivery.
A claim is evaluated deterministically against fitment, approved part, authorised dealer, coverage window, installation evidence, and prior claims or replacements.
A reviewer accepts or declines a claim marked REQUIRES_REVIEW. No review step is implemented.

source.reference: Design Studio demo assumption pending dec_warranty_reviewer

exceptions.name: Part not found
exceptions.trigger: The searched part is not in the catalogue (unknown_part).
exceptions.recovery: Search again or give up; nothing is ordered.

exceptions.name: Part not orderable
exceptions.trigger: The part is not VERIFIED or not orderable online (not_orderable).
exceptions.recovery: Show the reason; the customer chooses another part.

exceptions.name: Ambiguous identification
exceptions.trigger: The machine variant must be identified before the right part is certain.
exceptions.recovery: Ask for the machine variant, then search again.

exceptions.name: Part does not fit the selected machine
exceptions.trigger: A fit is known to be wrong. The data holds no negative fitment records, so today this appears as NOT_RECORDED.

exceptions.name: Compatibility unknown
exceptions.trigger: No fitment record exists for the part and the selected machine (machine_mismatch).
exceptions.recovery: Today the order is refused; whether to allow it with a warning is undecided (dec_unknown_compatibility).

exceptions.name: Invalid contact details or address
exceptions.trigger: Malformed email or phone, or a destination that is not a recorded ship-to.
exceptions.recovery: Name the field and let the customer correct it.

exceptions.name: Missing stock data
exceptions.trigger: No depot has a recorded quantity for a line (stock UNKNOWN).
exceptions.recovery: The order cannot be placed from that depot; unknown is never treated as zero.

exceptions.name: Insufficient stock
exceptions.trigger: No depot has enough known stock for every line.
exceptions.recovery: The order cannot be placed; partial fulfilment is undecided (dec_partial_fulfilment).

exceptions.name: No shipping route
exceptions.trigger: No recorded route from a capable depot to the destination.

exceptions.name: Duplicate order submission
exceptions.trigger: The same place-order key arrives again, possibly at the same time.
exceptions.recovery: The existing order is returned and continues; no second order is created.

exceptions.name: Allocation failure
exceptions.trigger: A line cannot be reserved when allocation runs.
exceptions.recovery: The processor retries, rejects or cancels the order; no stock changed.

exceptions.name: Concurrent stock allocation
exceptions.trigger: Another order reserved the same units first.
exceptions.recovery: The later allocation fails atomically and follows the allocation-failure path.

exceptions.name: Allocation released before dispatch
exceptions.trigger: The processor releases reserved stock before the shipment leaves the depot.
exceptions.recovery: The stock returns to the depot; the processor allocates again or cancels the order.

exceptions.name: Shipment exception
exceptions.trigger: A dispatched shipment reports an exception.
exceptions.recovery: Resume the shipment, or record a failed delivery.

exceptions.name: Delivery failure
exceptions.recovery: The order is cancelled; refunds and returns are undecided (dec_returns_refunds).

exceptions.name: Dealer service cancelled
exceptions.trigger: The dealer service is cancelled after delivery.
exceptions.recovery: The order can still be completed.

exceptions.name: Insufficient warranty evidence
exceptions.trigger: The evaluation lacks the data needed for a decision (INSUFFICIENT_DATA).
exceptions.recovery: Ask the dealer for the missing evidence and resubmit.

decisions.question: Does any order need approval before allocation, and if so above which threshold and by whom? The implemented flow has no approval step.
Should an order be partly fulfilled when no single depot can supply every line? Today it cannot be placed.
When fitment is not recorded for the selected machine, should the order be refused (as implemented) or allowed with a warning? Should explicit incompatibility be recorded?
How are prices, totals and credit limits determined? Order totals are not calculated today.
What is the returns and refunds policy after a failed delivery or a declined claim?
Should identification requirements be enforced before ordering?
Who reviews warranty claims marked REQUIRES_REVIEW, and how?
Who besides the project owner may approve application designs?

integrations.name: Catalogue and fitment data
integrations.failure_handling: Graph unavailable returns 503 graph_unavailable; nothing is guessed.

integrations.name: Order workflow records
integrations.system: Noordveld graph via the order service (fixed write queries)
integrations.failure_handling: A transaction commits completely or not at all; a constraint conflict is reported as a conflict.

integrations.name: Shipment tracking
integrations.system: Synthetic tracking events (no live carrier integration)
integrations.failure_handling: No carrier outage handling exists; a live integration would need one.

states.label: Check fitment for the selected machine
Review and place the order
preconditions: Every line has a depot with known stock of at least the quantity and a recorded route
postconditions: An order exists with status NEW; placing it again with the same key returns it

states.label: Reserve stock
preconditions: The order is NEW, ALLOCATION_FAILED or ALLOCATION_RELEASED
postconditions: Every line is reserved, or the order is ALLOCATION_FAILED and no stock changed

states.label: Ship and track
preconditions: The order is READY_TO_SHIP and a shipment exists
postconditions: The shipment is delivered, has an exception, or delivery failed
